name: io.github.tonyyang0504/microsoft_graph-mcp
description: Outlook / Microsoft 365 (messaging): me, list_inbound, get_thread, send, reply, mark_read. Every too

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MICROSOFT_GRAPH_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Application (client) ID of the Microsoft Entra app registration.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MICROSOFT_GRAPH_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret of the app registration ('Only required for web apps'); leave empty for a public client. Sent in the form body of POST https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/oauth2/v2.0/token.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MICROSOFT_GRAPH_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Refresh token from a one-time authorization-code consent including offline_access and the delegated scopes User.Read Mail.ReadWrite Mail.Send. Microsoft may return a new refresh token on every refresh; the runtime keeps it in memory and, with PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR set, saves it to <dir>/<platform>.json (mode 0600).
